editorial.blurb: A neighborhood gem where skilled sushi craftsmanship meets deeply flavorful ramen, with a service team that genuinely cares.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Salmon Paradise roll—it's the standout sushi item regulars rave about—and ask for the kimchi fries on the side; skip the hard-boiled eggs and request soy sauce for the broth if you want to customize your ramen experience.
